panel_description: NOVA classification validation harness (Monteiro 2019 canonical examples)

rows.label: Apple, raw, with skin (1696)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: "edible parts of plants ... after separation from nature" — raw fruit is the canonical NOVA 1 example.

rows.label: Spinach, New Zealand, raw (2132)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: raw vegetable.

rows.label: Chicken broiler wing meat+skin roasted (629)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: muscle meat altered only by roasting (preservation/cooking) qualifies as NOVA 1.
rows.cnf_food_description: Chicken, broiler, wing, meat and skin, roasted

rows.label: Milk, fluid, whole 3.25% (113)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: pasteurised plain milk is explicitly listed in the NOVA 1 preservation methods.
rows.cnf_food_description: Milk, fluid, whole, pasteurized, homogenized, 3.25% M.F.

rows.label: Chia seeds, dried (2511)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: dried seeds (NOVA 1 preservation).

rows.label: Broccoli, frozen, spears, boiled (2026)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: freezing AND boiling are both explicit NOVA 1 preservation/cooking methods. This row was the OIL/BOILED substring-bug failure pre-2026-05-23.

rows.label: Sweets, sugars, granulated (4318)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: "sugar ... substances derived from Group 1 foods or from nature by ... refining" — canonical NOVA 2.

rows.label: Vegetable oil, olive (422)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: "oils ... derived from Group 1 by pressing".

rows.label: Butter, whipped (16)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.1: "butter ... derived from Group 1".

rows.label: Beef, cured, corned beef, canned (2791)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.2: "canned fish ... cured meats" — cured + canned places this firmly in NOVA 3.

rows.label: Cheese, edam (29)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.2: "cheeses" listed as canonical NOVA 3 (non-alcoholic fermentation preservation).

rows.label: Bread, white, commercial (4066)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.2: "freshly made breads" — commercial plain white bread without ultra-processed additives is NOVA 3.

rows.label: Pork, cured, bacon, raw (1936)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.2: cured pork is NOVA 3 by preservation method.

rows.label: Apple juice, canned (1495)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.2: 100% fruit juice without added ingredients is NOVA 3 (canning preservation of NOVA 1 fruit).
rows.cnf_food_description: Apple juice, canned or bottled, without added vitamin C

rows.label: Wiener (frankfurter), beef (1185)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3 LITERAL CANONICAL EXAMPLE: "reconstituted meat products" includes hot dogs / frankfurters. Pre-fix this was misclassified as NOVA 3.

rows.label: Fast foods, hot dog, plain (4644)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3 LITERAL CANONICAL EXAMPLE: hot dog at fast-food chain = reconstituted meat product + commercial bun with dough conditioners. Pre-fix this was misclassified as NOVA 3.

rows.label: Pizza, pepperoni, frozen, cooked (4962)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3 LITERAL CANONICAL EXAMPLE: "pre-prepared frozen dishes". Pre-fix this was misclassified as NOVA 3.
rows.cnf_food_description: Pizza, cheese and pepperoni, frozen, cooked

rows.label: Plant-based beverage, almond, sweetened (7225)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3: sweetened plant-based beverage = added-sugar industrial formulation in the SSB band.
rows.cnf_food_description: Plant-based beverage, almond beverage, vanilla flavoured, sweetened, fortified, refrigerated

rows.label: Cereal, ready to eat, Honey Bunches of Oats (1314)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3 LITERAL CANONICAL EXAMPLE: "breakfast cereal" packaged ready-to-eat sweetened cereal.
rows.cnf_food_description: Cereal, ready to eat, Honey Bunches of Oats (Honey Roasted), Post

rows.label: Dessert, frozen, ice cream, vanilla, rich (4157)
rows.monteiro_rationale: Monteiro §4.3: ice cream is the classic NOVA 4 dairy dessert (emulsifiers, stabilizers, added sugars).
rows.cnf_food_description: Dessert, frozen, ice cream, vanilla, rich, 16% M.F.
